definitions.explanation: A series of objects or people arranged in a line.
A line of people waiting for something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前列|ぜんれつ}→前列：20217_zenretsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: To sit in the front row.
The seats are arranged in three rows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{列|れつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
{列|れつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割|わ}り{込|こ}まないで→割り込む：06973_warikomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{列|れつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できていた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: There was a queue in front of the ramen shop.

notes:
{列|れつ} refers to an arrangement of things or people in a line, row, or queue.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧: queue, procession, matrix (math)
- ⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧: train
- ⟦{整列|せいれつ}→整列：15265_seiretsu⟧: lining up, alignment
- ⟦{前列|ぜんれつ}→前列：20217_zenretsu⟧: front row
- ⟦{後列|こうれつ}→後列：20218_kouretsu⟧: back row
- ⟦{列島|れっとう}→列島：11739_rettou⟧: archipelago, chain of islands

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {列|れつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to stand in line
- {列|れつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to form a line
- {列|れつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割|わ}り{込|こ}む→割り込む：06973_warikomu⟧: to cut in line
- {列|れつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乱|みだ}す→乱す：11412_midasu⟧: to break ranks

USAGE:
{列|れつ} is more formal than ⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧ for queues. In daily speech, ⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (people lining up) is common.
